items.title: Log sets from the lock screen
items.body: Tap how hard the set was right on the lock screen or in the Dynamic Island, adjust kg with − / +, and see your workout's progress and heart rate. When you finish, a summary card stays for 15 minutes.

items.title: Bigger moves, steady screen
items.body: The movement picture is twice the size and everything in the player stays in the same place. Up next shows what follows; tap or swipe it up for the workout map.

items.title: Warm-ups that fit you
items.body: 5 minutes of easy cardio to get warm, a little longer before leg day, in the morning or from 50. Set your usual workout time in Training profile.

items.title: Today means today
items.body: On the Quest map, your next stage now says Today, Tomorrow or Next, instead of Today for any day.
